title: Единая понятная архитектура Docara
summary: Перевести Docara на один content-first конвейер, где каждая страница хранится в Markdown, композиция — в JSON, компоненты — в реестре, а HTML всегда является производным результатом.
done_when: Every public route has exactly one Markdown source in content/<locale>.
Public prose is absent from engine arrays, language packs and component registry records.
A typed Document IR and one renderer registry serve all supported Markdown nodes.
All ui.* and docara.* components pass through one Smart Component Gateway.
Full and single-page builds use one PageBuilder and match semantically.
All declared locales build independent route trees with explicit missing-page policy.
Legacy parallel projectors and trusted HTML paths are deleted after parity evidence.
Documentation, graph, code, tests and generated starter agree.
scope: Localization, assets, diagnostics and update safety
Migration and removal of legacy paths
non_goals: Visual redesign unrelated to the unified pipeline
Backward compatibility with unpublished experimental storage formats
evidence_policy: Do not infer readiness from activity or file count.
Each stage needs code mapping, tests and exact-revision evidence.
Legacy deletion requires positive parity and negative no-reference checks.
Release readiness remains a separate gate.
